text:
mike: deploybot blocked rollout for release 2026.03.21 - tag `2026.03.21` resolves to different digests in gcr eu-west vs ecr us-east during promotion. Holding promotion. :thinking:

anya: logs? what failed exactly?

mike: snippet from release-checker:
```
# gcr check (eu-west)
gcloud container images describe gcr.io/myproj/app:2026.03.21 --show-occurrences
imageDigest: sha256:aaabbb111
# ecr check (us-east)
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name app-service --image-ids imageTag=2026.03.21
{"images":[],"failures":[{"imageId":{"imageTag":"2026.03.21"},"failureReason":"ImageNotFound: digest mismatch expected sha256:aaabbb111"}]}
```

deploybot: Promotion blocked — reason: cross-registry digest drift (manifest orphaning / tag shadow). Auto-hold applied. To unhold, provide a pinned digest and justification or `@deploybot unhold 1829990000` with verification logs.

carlos: This looks like an orphan manifest problem: CI pushed an amd64 image then the arm64 runner pushed and the tag was updated before the manifestlist publish propagated to mirrors. Mirrors saw different single-arch digest. Two short fixes: 1) retag the late artifact and rebuild a manifestlist from a single orchestrator job, or 2) pin routing to the source-region digest until we can republish.

anya: Which is faster for unblocking stable? I want minimal customer blast radius.

mike: Pinning the route to the source digest is fastest. Retag+manifestlist republish is cleaner but needs a manual push or CI run and a change-window if cross-region. Proposed immediate steps:
- open routing PR to pin stable to sha256:aaabbb111 (source eu-west digest) temporarily
- schedule manifestlist republish from the canonical builder at 15:40 UTC (change window) which will `skopeo copy` or `docker manifest create` + `push` from a single host
- after successful republish and verification (`skopeo inspect --raw` shows unified manifestlist digest), `@deploybot unhold 1829990000` with the manifestlist digest and verification logs

carlos: commands for manual republish if CI blocked:
```
# pull both arch images by digest and create manifestlist
docker pull gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:aaabbb111
docker pull gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:cccddd222
docker manifest create gcr.io/myproj/app:2026.03.21 gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:aaabbb111 gcr.io/myproj/app@sha256:cccddd222
docker manifest push gcr.io/myproj/app:2026.03.21
# verify on mirror
skopeo inspect --raw docker://us-east-1.dkr.ecr.amazonaws.com/app:2026.03.21
```

anya: Rollback criteria while pinned: revert routing immediately if we observe >1% 5xxs sustained for 5m or p95 latency regresses >250ms vs baseline for 5m. If rollback triggered, revert to previous digest and abort republish until post-window.

mike: I'll open the routing PR now and add release_notes entry: "2026.03.21 - rollout held due to tag digest drift across registries; stable pinned to eu-west digest; manifestlist republish scheduled; CI manifest orchestration fix queued."

deploybot: Log: hold created by deploybot at 1829990000. Current state: HOLD. Recorded actions: pin digest, republish manifestlist, validate, unhold.
